summary: Frontend-only testing of new /privacy-policy and /terms-and-conditions legal pages. Initial run revealed a critical crash: Footer.jsx used <Link> without importing it from react-router-dom, causing 'ReferenceError: Link is not defined' on every page (home + both legal pages showed React error overlay, no content rendered). Applied a one-line trivial import fix in Footer.jsx and re-ran all scenarios: home renders (hero 3D canvas, sections, contact, footer), footer Privacy/Terms links do SPA navigation (no full reload), Privacy page renders with H1 'Privacy Policy' and 11 sections, Terms page renders with H1 'Terms & Conditions', legal-back-home and legal-logo-link return home correctly, and direct URL loads of both /privacy-policy and /terms-and-conditions work (no 404). Zero console/page errors after fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'`. Caused ReferenceError that blank-screened the entire app (home + legal pages). Fixed by testing agent.

action_items: Verify the Footer.jsx Link import fix (already applied). Consider adding a smoke test or ESLint no-undef rule so this class of bug fails CI.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx used <Link> without importing it — a linter with no-undef would have caught this. Recommend running eslint in CI.

LegalPage.jsx sets window.scrollTo(0,0) on mount which is fine, but Lenis smooth scroll instance may retain scroll state on route changes; consider calling window.__lenis?.scrollTo(0,{immediate:true}) for consistency (minor).
Both legal pages hard-code 'Last updated: June 2026' as a string prop — acceptable, but consider a shared constant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal pages feature verified working end-to-end after adding missing Link import to Footer.jsx. Home page hero canvas + all sections + smooth SPA nav to /privacy-policy and /terms-and-conditions + direct URL loads all working with 0 console errors.
rca of the issue: RCA: Footer.jsx JSX referenced <Link to=...> for the new Privacy/Terms footer links but the file's import statement only included lucide-react icons. React threw 'ReferenceError: Link is not defined' during Footer render, and since Footer is used in HomePage and LegalPage the error propagated to every route via error boundary overlay. Repro: navigate to any route pre-fix. Mitigation applied: added `import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';` to Footer.jsx.
